rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Elenchus is an adversarial verification system that orchestrates multi-round code review sessions between verifier and critic roles to systematically identify security, correctness, reliability, maintainability, and performance issues. It provides state management, context sharing, and automated verification loops through MCP tools, with advanced features like differential analysis for incremental verification, response caching to reduce token usage, function-level code chunking for large codebases, and quality safeguards including periodic full verification and confidence scoring. Designed for thorough code verification workflows where multiple AI agents collaborate to catch issues that single-pass reviews might miss.
